Nina (People Ops): FYI - Riley Park submitted resignation, last day 2025-04-18. Need to coordinate benefits cutoff, SSO deprovisioning timing, and transfer of any service account access. 
Tom (IT): 👋 noted. Can you confirm whether Riley has any admin roles or KMS access? That determines handoff steps.
Nina (People Ops): She does own two service accounts for the evaluation pipeline and has KMS decrypt access for the A/B test keys. Jae can confirm the required handoffs.
Jae (Manager): Riley will hand over repo permissions to Alex and create runbooks for the evaluation pipeline by EOD 2025-04-15. For KMS, we need Ben to approve key rotation and grant access to the backup owner before removal.
Ben (Security): On it. We should not rotate keys until backup principal is confirmed. Please add the backup IAM: alex@redwood.com and tag the keys with "pending-offboard".
Tom (IT): Suggested deprovision timeline: keep SSO and laptop access until last day morning, then deactivate. That avoids blocking any final tasks. Also need to collect the company laptop and dongles.
Nina (People Ops): Sounds good. Riley, do you have a preferred pickup time for equipment return? We can do courier or drop-off at HQ. :package:
Riley Park: Drop-off at HQ on 04/18 morning works for me. I'll leave the laptop with reception and fill the asset form.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar event created: "Riley Park - Exit checklist" 2025-04-18 09:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/exit-1934567890
Nina (People Ops): COBRA/benefits: benefits end date is 2025-04-30 (coverage through end of month). COBRA notice email should go out on 2025-04-19. Payroll: final paycheck will include prorated salary + unused PTO, paid on next regular payday 2025-04-25.
Jae (Manager): Can we get confirmation that the COBRA vendor has updated Riley's email and mailing address? HR ops?
Nina (People Ops): Confirmed with benefits vendor — they have the last known address on file. I'll attach the COBRA packet and proof of mailing to Riley's file.
Ben (Security): For KMS & service accounts: please run the following checklist before deprovisioning:
```
- Add alex@redwood.com to KMS admin for key-id: projects/redwood/keys/eval-2022
- Transfer ownership of service-account: eval-pipeline-sa -> alex@redwood.com
- Rotate keys after confirmation of successful decrypt tests
- Remove riley@redwood.com from all admin groups
```
Tom (IT): I'll run the account deprovision script on 2025-04-18 at 10:00 PT after equipment is checked in. Script we use:
```
./deprovision-user --email riley@redwood.com --sso off --revoke-tokens --audit-log
```
Nina (People Ops): Quick ask — Riley agreed to an exit interview. Is 04/20 at 11:00 PT ok for folks from People Ops + Manager?
Riley Park: 04/20 11:00 PT works. Happy to give feedback.
Jae (Manager): I'll attend. Thanks Riley.
Ben (Security): One more note — please confirm if Riley had any personal SSH keys on build machines. If so, we need to purge authorized_keys and rotate host keys if used for automation.
Tom (IT): I'll scan known build hosts and report findings by EOD 2025-04-16. If any keys are found, we'll revoke and rotate.
Nina (People Ops): Excellent. Action items recap: 1) IT (Tom) — run deprovision script 04/18 10:00 PT and collect laptop. 2) Security (Ben) — approve KMS handoff + rotate after tests. 3) Manager (Jae) — confirm backup owners and accept repo/service account handoffs. 4) People Ops (Nina) — send COBRA notice 04/19, schedule exit interview 04/20. Everyone, please react with :white_check_mark: when you've made progress.
Tom (IT): ✅ I'll post confirmation when the deprovision completes.
Ben (Security): ✅ Added alex@redwood.com to KMS ACLs and tagged keys. Waiting on decrypt tests.
Jae (Manager): ✅ Handoff PR opened and reviewers added.
Riley Park: Thanks team — appreciate the smooth process. :wave:
